verdict.rationale: Chargebee's docs describe "Official Chargebee client libraries and framework adapters" and give a concrete Node.js SDK install command (npm install chargebee), so official SDKs exist to build against. The evidence names only one language and shows little of the SDKs' depth. Missing for 10: evidence of other language SDKs and their coverage, in-depth SDK reference or usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official Chargebee client libraries and framework adapters to integrate Chargebee into your application.
